entry_timeframe_note: Use Daily for bias. Drop to 4H for entry timing — look for the same TWB breakout signal on 4H to confirm before entering.

market_context.benchmark_filter: BTC must be above its 50-day SMA for any altcoin bullish bias. If BTC is below its 50-day SMA, default all alts to neutral or bearish — alts rarely sustain moves when BTC is in a downtrend. ETH can act as secondary confirmation for non-BTC majors.
market_context.cycle_note: Be aware of the broader BTC halving cycle. Post-halving alt seasons (6-18 months after halving) historically produce the strongest momentum signals. In late bear markets, even strong TWB signals are traps — require BTC above 200-day SMA as an additional filter.

bias_criteria_note: bearish criteria = exit/avoid signal on longs ONLY. Short-side futures entries require separate confirmation — never short alts unless BTC is also breaking down.

bullish: BTC is above its 50-day SMA (benchmark filter passes)
Coin is printing higher highs and higher lows on the daily
Trendlines with Breaks Oscillator [LuxAlgo] shows a recent bullish breakout signal
Breakout candle volume is significantly higher than the prior 5-10 day average (in USD terms)
Price is approaching or at the upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band but NOT extended outside it
Clear catalyst present: protocol upgrade, ETF news, exchange listing, BTC halving cycle tailwind, or major partnership
bearish: BTC is below its 50-day SMA — alt longs are high risk
Coin is printing lower highs and lower lows on the daily
Trendlines with Breaks Oscillator [LuxAlgo] shows a bearish breakdown signal
Price has broken back below a prior breakout trendline on volume
Price is extended outside the lower Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band
BTC dominance is rising sharply — capital rotating out of alts into BTC
neutral: BTC is consolidating near its 50-day SMA — unclear direction
Coin is consolidating — no clear higher highs/lows pattern
No breakout signal from Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo]
Price is chopping inside the Nadaraya-Watson Envelope bands
Volume is average or below average — no catalyst driving the move

spot_long: Coin consolidating near local highs (flag, pennant, or horizontal resistance)
Trendlines with Breaks Oscillator [LuxAlgo] prints bullish breakout signal on Daily
Confirm signal on 4H chart — same TWB breakout visible on lower timeframe
Breakout candle volume significantly above 5-10 day average (in USD)
Price approaching upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band but NOT fully outside it
Clear catalyst identifiable — protocol event, listing, or macro tailwind
futures_long: Use maximum 3x leverage — crypto volatility makes higher leverage account-threatening
Only enter futures longs when Daily AND 4H TWB signals align
Reduce position size by 50% vs spot equivalent (leverage amplifies crypto's gap risk)

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below breakout candle low or nearest prior swing low on Daily. For futures, tighten stop to 4H swing low. Exit immediately if BTC breaks its 50-day SMA — do not hold alt longs into a BTC breakdown.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 of position when price touches or pierces upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band — crypto moves fast and bands get tagged quickly.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Scale out another 1/3 at 2R (double the initial risk). Trail remainder with 4H 9 EMA as dynamic stop.
exit_criteria.take_profit_3: Exit final portion if price closes below the 4H 9 EMA for two consecutive 4H candles — momentum shift signal.
exit_criteria.emergency_exit: Exit entire position immediately if BTC drops more than 8% intraday — systemic sell-off, no alt is safe.

risk_rules: Maximum 2% account risk per crypto trade (higher volatility than stocks)
Maximum 3 open crypto positions at once — correlation is high, they move together
No altcoin longs if BTC is below its 50-day SMA
Futures maximum 3x leverage — never higher for crypto
Reduce position size 50% on futures vs equivalent spot trade
No crypto trading during major macro events (FOMC, CPI) — crypto amplifies macro moves
Never average down on a losing crypto trade — crypto can drop 30-50% and not recover for months
If BTC drops 8%+ intraday, exit ALL crypto positions regardless of individual chart
Do not trade meme coins or coins below $2B market cap — too manipulable
Coinbase listing = valid catalyst, but enter AFTER the initial listing pump fades (not on the spike)
tradeable_note: User trades on Coinbase only. For each symbol in the scan, flag whether it is available on Coinbase (most large caps are: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, LINK, XLM, LTC, BCH, etc.). If a coin is NOT on Coinbase, mark it SKIP — do not generate an entry plan for it. BNB is NOT on Coinbase. USDT pairs are not applicable — use USD pairs only (e.g. COINBASE:ETHUSD not BINANCE:ETHUSDT).
asset_notes: Large-cap crypto screened by market cap and USD volume. TradingView's crypto screener has no exchange filter — Coinbase availability must be checked per coin (see tradeable_note). Crypto moves faster and further than stocks — a 10-15% daily move is normal, not a signal to exit. The NW Envelope bands will be tagged and exceeded more frequently than in stocks; use the ▲/▼ signals directionally, not as hard exits. BTC correlation is the most important filter — when BTC leads, alts follow with a 1-3 day lag. Volume in USD (not coin count) is the key confirmation — a breakout on low USD volume is almost always a manipulation spike. The 4H entry confirmation prevents chasing gaps that open on low liquidity.
